Dear Diya, ❤️

On your birthday, there are so many things I want to tell you.

Some people enter our lives like a small chapter,
but somehow they become an entire story in our hearts.

The moments we laughed together, the little fights we had,
and all the things we understood without even saying them —
every one of those memories is precious to me.

No matter how much life changes,
the beautiful memories I have with you will always stay in my heart.

Today is your special day.
I hope your life is always filled with happiness, peace, love, and beautiful moments.
May you get everything your heart wishes for.

Happy Birthday, Ponneh. ❤️

Seeing you happy will always be one of the greatest joys in my life. ❤️

❤️
Still,
I Love You Diya ❤️
By, Basil Xolo
